CheckTitle: Avoid the use of the root account
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether the root user's password or access keys were used within the last day.
Risk: Routine root usage bypasses least privilege and IAM guardrails, and makes credential theft of the most powerful identity far more likely.

Recommendation.Text: Use the root user only for the few tasks that require it; perform daily administration with federated or IAM identities.
